features.name: Spontaneous Divine Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast known divine spells from the cleric spell list using Charisma without preparing them.

features.name: Mystery
features.summary: Choose a divine mystery that grants class skills, bonus spells, revelations, and a final revelation.
features.scaling: mystery spells at every even level

features.name: Oracle's Curse
features.summary: Choose a permanent supernatural curse that carries both a hindrance and benefits that advance with effective oracle level.
features.scaling: oracle level plus half non-oracle levels

features.name: Orisons
features.summary: Know a number of 0-level oracle spells and cast known orisons at will.

features.name: Revelation
features.summary: Choose a supernatural power from the selected mystery.

features.name: Cure or Inflict Spells
features.summary: Choose all cure spells or all inflict spells and add them to spells known as soon as each can be cast.

features.name: Mystery Spell
features.summary: Add the selected mystery's next bonus spell to spells known.

features.name: Revelation
features.summary: Choose another supernatural power from the selected mystery.

features.name: Spell Exchange
features.summary: At each even oracle level, exchange one eligible known spell for another spell of the same level.
